newsitem.title: MALTA: Malta's Middle Sea Insurance see profits rise.
newsitem.headline: Malta's Middle Sea Insurance see profits rise.

text.p: Malta's Middle Sea Insurance group made a pre-tax profit of 946,466 Maltese Lira ($2.6 million) in the first six months of the year, up 8.4 percent over the same period last year, group chairman Mario Grech said on Wednesday.
"Earnings per share for the first six months were five cents compared to four cents during the same period last year, he added.
The group's net asset value per share rose by three cents to 1.15 million Maltese Lira.
Grech said the group was consolidating its direct underwriting, indigenous and international reinsurance and group life business.

Premium income from these operations had risen by over six percent to reach 5.05 million Maltese lira ($14 million) but there was a deterioration in the underwriting result of the holding due to higher pressures on rates and terms in local and international insurance markets.
